{"id":1904210439,"question_id":3263,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1769940698,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1904210439/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Divide an Array Into Subarrays With Minimum Cost I","memory":"30.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minimumCost(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int cost = nums[0];\n\n        int firstmini = INT_MAX;\n        int secondmini = INT_MAX;\n\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            if(nums[i] < firstmini)\n            {\n                secondmini = firstmini;\n                firstmini = nums[i];\n            }\n            else \n            {\n                secondmini = min(secondmini ,nums[i]);\n            }\n        }\n        return cost + firstmini + secondmini;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"divide-an-array-into-subarrays-with-minimum-cost-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1627}
